name: agents_list

name: apply_add_skill
label: Add a skill
description: Add a reusable skill (prompt fragment). applicable_to is a JSON array string of agent types, e.g. ["SHCA","GO"].

name: apply_add_tool
label: Add a tool / MCP server
description: Add a custom tool. tier = http_action|mcp_server|openapi|typescript. `spec` is a JSON object string, tier-specific: http_action {url, method, parameters_schema, body_template}; mcp_server {server_url, transport?, tools:[names]}; openapi {server_url, operations:[{operation_id,method,path,description}]}; typescript {source_code, parameters_schema}. `credential` (optional JSON object {name,type,header_name}) scaffolds a pending credential.

name: apply_create_credential
label: Scaffold a credential
description: Create a credential SHELL (no secret) for a tool to use. A human enters the secret later in Settings → Credentials. type = bearer|api_key|basic; header_name is required for api_key.

name: apply_model_change
label: Change a template's model
description: Change an agent template's model (template-only; future instances). template_id is 'go' (GO) or 'default-shca' (SHCA). model must be a supported model id.

description: Independent Platform Research finish-tool (ends your turn): log up to 15 newly-released items. `entries` is a JSON ARRAY STRING; each item: {fingerprint, category(model|tool|skill), title, summary, url, released_at, source}. fingerprint is the dedup key e.g. 'model:gpt-5' — re-logging refreshes, never duplicates.

name: registry_get
label: Get a registry finding
description: Fetch one finding by id, with full detail, evidence, impact, verdict and adoption_path.

name: registry_search
label: Search the platform registry
description: List registry findings. All filters optional (empty = no filter). Returns lean rows; use registry_get for full detail. Call this BEFORE researching to avoid duplicating existing findings.

name: registry_verdict
label: Record integration verdict
description: Integration reviewer: write your INDEPENDENT verdict into a finding's row. verdict=adopt_now ONLY if the finding maps to one of the 4 no-code ops (change_template_model|add_skill|add_tool|create_credential) — then you MUST also set op_type + op_params (the execution spec). Anything needing code, a migration, infra, or a new provider = out_of_scope. op_params is a JSON object string. For models, supported_today=true only if provider family is gemini/anthropic.

name: registry_write
label: Write research findings
description: Producer finish-tool (ends your turn): submit your ranked findings for this run. `entries` is a JSON ARRAY STRING; each item: {fingerprint, category(model|tool|mcp|skill), title, summary, detail, evidence(list of urls), impact(object), provider_family, target_role}. fingerprint is the role-aware dedup key e.g. 'model:claude-haiku-5:GO', 'mcp:firecrawl' or 'skill:tdd' — re-using one updates that finding instead of duplicating. Cap: at most 2 models PER ROLE for model_research; 5 total for tool_research / skill_research.

name: reply_assistant
label: Reply to Assistant
description: Send a reply from GO back to the SHCA

name: research_spawn
label: Queue on-demand research
description: Steward only: request research on a SPECIFIC topic. This ENQUEUES it at the FRONT of the research queue (kind=model|tool|skill); the deterministic drainer runs it one-at-a-time end-to-end and the reviewer verdicts it — you do NOT run or review it yourself. Just tell the user it is queued. Use only when a human asks for NEW research; for 'what can we integrate?' read the registry instead.

name: research_status
label: Check research queue status
description: Steward: check whether a research/review sweep is already in flight. Call this BEFORE research_spawn/review_spawn — if busy=true, do NOT dispatch; tell the user a research is already running and they must wait.

name: review_spawn
label: Spawn integration review
description: Steward only: run integration review. Pass `sweep_id` (from a research_spawn you started) to review that research's findings; or `finding_id` to review one finding; or neither to review ALL pending findings.
